name: Dev (mise, Claude Code, GitHub CLI)
description: Thin template on a prebuilt image with mise (Node.js and other runtimes), the Claude Code CLI, the GitHub CLI and the Starship prompt. Logins, settings, tool installs and shell history persist across rebuilds in named volumes.

imageVariant.description: Prebuilt image tag: a major version (1) gets compatible updates only; also 1.2, 1.2.3, latest or an exact build like 1.2.3-2026-11-07:

volumePrefix.description: Prefix for the shared volumes (Claude Code, GitHub CLI, git config). Containers using the same prefix share logins:
